title: Figure 9 (20616): rendering of a row of seven orange lights in the Texas night sky
description: Digital illustration of seven glowing orange-white lights in a slightly uneven horizontal row against a black background. Caption (partly redacted under 1843(a)(2)): "Figure 9 (20616) ... of Lights in the Texas Sky pulled the MUFON report off CMS and created a drawing based on the sighting report." Above is the end of a highlighted witness account noting jets were often seen and heard afterward.
